name: base-rustic-ground
description: Game ground behind the rustic base concepts: map 04's persistent base site (old base tiles, glow, base lights and HP bars hidden) at 64 px per metre and as a wide 32 px per metre view for the grown build area, plus a free meadow for the outpost sheet; noon and night.

setup.code: const s = ck.scene; const walk = (list, fn) => { for (const o of list) { fn(o); if (o.list) walk(o.list, fn); } }; const hidden = []; const hide = () => walk(s.children.list, o => { const k = o.texture && o.texture.key; const n = (o.constructor && o.constructor.name) || ''; if (k === 'base' || k === '__WHITE' || (k && k.startsWith('__base_accent_glow')) || /BarSdf|HealthBar|Wildlife/.test(n)) { o.setVisible(false); hidden.push(n || k); } }); hide(); const seen = new Set(); const visit = (o, d) => { if (!o || typeof o !== 'object' || seen.has(o) || d > 4) return null; seen.add(o); if (typeof o.setLight === 'function' && typeof o.releaseLight === 'function' && typeof o.pulse === 'function') return o; for (const k of Object.keys(o)) { let r = null; try { r = visit(o[k], d + 1); } catch (e) {} if (r) return r; } return null; }; const lighting = visit(s, 0); if (lighting) { const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(lighting); if (!proto.__fdBaseless) { const orig = proto.setLight; proto.setLight = function (key, preset, ...rest) { if (preset === 'baseGlow' || preset === 'spore_turret') return; return orig.call(this, key, preset, ...rest); }; proto.__fdBaseless = true; } } s.events.on('postupdate', hide); s.events.on('prerender', hide); ck.warnings.push('base lights filtered: ' + !!lighting + ', hidden: ' + [...new Set(hidden)].join(','));
